style.register: 游戏指南体，简体中文，简洁直陈，不用敬语，不用『您』。
style.numbers: 数字、百分比、游戏内数值原样保留（如 10%、+5%）。
style.placeholders: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 等占位符必须原样保留且不得增删、不得调换顺序；它们代表图标或链接。
style.markup: 不要输出 HTML 标签；保留原文的换行与项目符号结构。
style.properNouns: 国家、人物、舰名等专有名词使用通用中文译名（如 German Reich → 德意志国，Adolf Hitler → 阿道夫·希特勒）；Paradox 未汉化的专有名词可保留英文并加中文注释。
style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

units.en: Any army leader: Is a field Marshal Skill Level more than 8
Is a field Marshal Skill Level more than 8

As Chinese Soviet Republic, play on non-historical in order to prevent the Sino-Japanese war ( Japan going communist is ideal). Make a fallback line on your capital and declare an early war on China while holding your capital with 9-12 divisions. Research infantry equipment and artillery only (at some point some of your divisions may run out of organization and die, so deploy a few extra divisions before it happens). If the AI stops attacking you, bait it to attack by training your divisions. If a General becomes level 9 before your field marshal, you may promote the General to field marshal and you will get the achievement.

The Dragon Swallowed the SunAs Manchukuo, Break free from Japan and annex your former Overlord without being in a faction.

Note: To get the achievement_the_dragon_swallowed_the_sun country flag, you must annex Japan without being in a faction. The "not in a faction" check is done when Japan gets annexed, so theoretically you are free to join factions during the game if you want to, as long as you leave before you annex Japan. Remember that if you call your faction members to war, you will not be able to leave until after the peace conference. For detailed strategies, see The Dragon Swallowed the Sun

Make a Man Out Of YouAs a Warlord, have at least 1,000,000 manpower queued up for deployment.
Has at least ⟦0⟧ manpower in deployment queue

Start as Guangxi Clique and get to 5 Army experience, either by training or hiring military advisor. Create a 1 width division and rush train as many as possible (make sure to set it to the highest priority in the recruiting tab so it gets guns first). Deploy them as soon as they reach the minimum training level and just switch them to the normal template. Note: You can only train 75% of the manpower currently on the field with a minimum of 100.00K. So that means you must have at least 1,333,334 manpower on the field to do this achievement.
Monarchy is Back in FashionAs Germany, Bring back the Kaiser and ensure that Italy is controlled by Victor Emmanuel by killing Mussolini.
Wilhelm II is the current country leader Italy has Vittorio Emanuele III as the current country leader
⟦0⟧ has ⟦1⟧ as the current country leader

(This guide requires Götterdämmerung disabled.) Follow the Return of the Kaiser and the Focus on the True Enemy path in the Oppose Hitler branch until you get to the Assassinate Mussolini focus (AI will always agree to assassinate Mussolini). Wilhelm II must be your leader and he must not die before the focus is complete. Note that you can get the achievement just by placing Wilhelm II in the German Empire throne if the non-historical AI choses without your intervention to get rid of Mussolini and place Victor Emmanuel as king.

Team AmericaAs the U.S.A., drop a nuclear bomb on Paris.
Dropped a nuclear bomb on Paris

As a democratic nation, build a lot of planes, namely strategic bombers and fighters, and rush nuclear technology. Germany will control Paris. When in the Allies, move your planes to the airfield on the British Isles and set them on mission to Northern France when the nuclear tech is ready and one nuke is available. Achieve air superiority and nuke Paris when ready.
History Repeated ItselfAs the U.S.A., Win against the Confederate States. Again.
The Second American Civil War has started Confederacy of American States exists
The Second American Civil War has started

Completing either Full Desegregation or Union Representation Act will trigger a civil war with the Confederacy. To help the United States win the war, complete the WPA branch and Guarantee the American Dream beforehand.
Georgia On My MindAs the U.S.A., own and fully control all three Georgias.

Collaborating with the Axis is the simplest route to achieving this. Help the Axis capitulate the Allies and the Comintern, and grab South Georgia (720) and Georgia (231). South Georgia (720) can also be obtained via the Reaffirm Monroe Doctrine focus.
To Arms in Dixie!As the U.S.A., start a new civil war as the South.

Complete America First and hire the fascist advisor. When ready and possible, complete Ally With the Silver Shirts to trigger the event chain leading to the civil war. For best results, complete Work With the Bund and Recruit the Free Corps.
Arsenal of DemocracyAs the U.S.A., have more than 300 military factories.
Ruling party is Democratic More than 300 military factories

The easiest way to earn this achievement is to simply play on historical as the United States and build as many Military factories as possible. The Arsenal of Democracy branch of the focus tree gives Military factories for free, so make sure you complete it, along with the WPA branch to boost your industry.
Underpaid, Undersexed, and Under EisenhowerAs the U.S.A., assume faction leadership of the Allies, and have over 50 expeditionary divisions from the United Kingdom.
Is in faction with the United Kingdom Is Faction leader Received at least 50 expeditionary forces from the United Kingdom
Received at least ⟦0⟧ expeditionary forces from the ⟦1⟧

Simply play historical and join the Allies. You need 50% more factories and fielded manpower than the United Kingdom, which shouldn't be a problem after a few years of buildup. Once you become faction leader, create an invasion order and press the button below the army to request 51 expeditionary forces and earn the achievement. Note: The UK will accept to send the 51 divisions you need if they have ~160 divisions, you can send them some of your own troops as expeditionary forces to get them past that number.
Last for a Thousand YearsAs the United Kingdom, accomplish the federation of the entire British Empire.

Can be done as any ideology. Make sure to improve relations and save up a few hundred Political Power before starting Hold the Imperial Conference. 300-400 political power is a good number to have saved before starting but if you can spare the time and effort, having around 600-700 political power will ensure success.

Follow the focus tree to Alliance with Germany. Justify against France and launch a naval invasion of Normandy. It is not necessary to call Germany into the war. If France is puppeted, the achievement will not fire. Annex all cores, territories, and colonies to be sure.
Nothing Wrong with our Bloody ShipsAs the United Kingdom, have at least 9 battlecruisers.

Battlecruisers are built with "Heavy Ship Hulls" and "Battlecruiser armor". Make the cheapest battlecruisers you can and build 6 at the same time ( United Kingdom start with 3) with all your dockyards assigned, build more dockyards to speed up construction.
